text:
Lina - Sales: Heads up — BetaCorp POC load test now, seeing ~8-12% 503 gateway errors across /v1/chat. Demo in 90min, they're stuck. Can infra triage?
Devon (eng): can you share a request id and sample timeframe + model? Also concurrent threads?
Lina - Sales: req-id b-9f8e7d6c5a window ~20:05-20:11 UTC. model=rwd-xl, client ramped to ~150rps with many long prompts.
DeployBot: config-change detected: kv-cache-size reduced from 256MB to 192MB for rwd-xl (strategy=evict-aggressive) at 19:58 UTC.
Ravi (infra): noting deploybot change. What's the error body? 5xx code only or message?
Lina - Sales: body shows 503 "gateway timeout" and sometimes 502. No 429. Customer logs attached.
Heather (oncall): pulling logs now. can someone re-run with X-Request-ID header so we can correlate?
Lina - Sales: asked them to replay one failing id and gave b-9f8e7d6c5a. They pasted tail:```
[2026-11-09T20:06:02Z] b-9f8e7d6c5a worker=gpupool-3 model=rwd-xl error=503 upstream="gateway timeout (kvcache_evicted)"
[2026-11-09T20:06:02Z] queue_len=1987 throttled=true reason=queue_full
[2026-11-09T20:06:03Z] autoscale.state=pending wait=22s target=gpupool-5
```
Devon (eng): looks like cache eviction combined with huge queue caused the gateway to time out when kernel couldn't serve request. Autoscaler still in cold-start.
Ravi (infra): checking routing rules — BetaCorp org is on a custom routing policy that explicitly opts out of burstpool fallback (policy flagged `no-burst-fallback=true`). That explains why requests stayed queued instead of routing to `gpupool-burst`.
Lina - Sales: they opted out because of data locality in the questionnaire. Can we do a temporary exception for demo?
Heather (oncall): we can toggle a per-request override to allow burst fallback for their org for the next 2 hours. Will patch rule now. :wrench:
Heather (oncall): applied override -> fallback allowed to gpupool-burst and compatible variant rwd-large.
Lina - Sales: BetaCorp re-ran the same script 3m after change -> error dropped to ~0.6%. Demo proceeding. Customer very happy. :grin:
Devon (eng): root cause notes for handoff: aggressive kv-cache size reduction (19:58) + long prompt distribution -> increased KV pressure; routing policy prevented automatic burst fallback; autoscaler cold-start lag ~20s. Combined led to transient 503s.
Ravi (infra): short-term mitigations: 1) revert kv-cache-size for rwd-xl to 256MB for POCs, 2) allow temporary burst-fallback for orgs doing load demos, 3) set autoscale warm pool min=1 for high-concurrency POCs.
Lina - Sales: client asked what options for guaranteed demo capacity are and cost delta vs default. Can someone give a quick ballpark?
Ravi (infra): quick ballpark — reserved burst pool for a few hours: +~$80/hr (one-off) depending on region; Dedicated commit required for steady traffic. I'll DM exact pricing to sales.
Devon (eng): post-mortem items: A) alert when queue_len > 1500 and autoscale.pending > 10s for a route, B) validate routing rules don't block burst-fallback for flagged POC orgs, C) re-evaluate kv-cache eviction policy for large-models during ramp tests.
Heather (oncall): I'll open incident ticket and assign owners. ETA for autoscale warm-pool change? Ravi?
Ravi (infra): aiming EOD for config change to warm-pool defaults; will add a POC runbook.
Lina - Sales: thanks team — I'll update BetaCorp and confirm whether they want reserved burst for next week's executive demo.
Devon (eng): short log snippet for customer report to explain 503:```
2026-11-09T20:06:02Z b-9f8e7d6c5a error=503 "gateway timeout (kvcache_evicted)"; queue_len=1987; autoscale_pending=22s; fallback_blocked_by_policy
```
Lina - Sales: perfect, sending now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
